shortDescription: Hong Kong property developer New World Development HKEX:17 said on Sunday its board had proposed a recapitalisation plan aimed at raising about HK$24.9 billion ($3.17 billion), according to a company filing.($1 = 7.8455 Hong Kong dollars)

children: Hong Kong property developer New World Development
said on Sunday its board had proposed a recapitalisation plan aimed at raising about HK$24.9 billion ($3.17 billion), according to a company filing.
New World Development has been trying to cut debt, dispose of assets and bolster liquidity amid tight credit conditions and a weak property market
The plan offers shareholders 11 new shares for every existing share at HK$0.90 each
The company plans to use the proceeds to prepay 10% of about HK$82 billion in bank loans and extend the maturity of the remaining 90% by two years
Controlling shareholder Chow Tai Fook, which owns about 45.3% of the company, has committed to take up its full entitlement, while the remaining shares will be fully underwritten
